text:
The key to the bull-pen, since he was more skillful,

        they gave to good Vergel, and because he was a close

        kinsman of those he has beneath his hand,

        since this town takes him for a lead ox.


        Though in this matter of horns he is master

        and dean of the faculty,

        a young bull, enemy of his brother,

        threw him to the ground with sinister intent.


        But since men have never seen

        one horn pierced by another horn,

        and Vergel is well loved by bulls,


        though this time they saw him hard pressed,

        he came out safe and sound, thanks be to Christ:

        for Vergel is fated against horns.

translation.title: To the Court Bailiff Pedro Vergel
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the bullfighting and cuckold 'horns' satire around Vergel.
